compound.label: Passé composé
compound.why: the everyday past: I washed, I have washed

compound.label: Plus-que-parfait
compound.why: had already happened before something else

links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem admirer-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem admir- is the nous form of the Présent (admirons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem admir- is the ils form of the Présent (admirent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.
